name: Dally Doo You Can Too! Numbers
summary: Dally Doo You Can Too! Numbers is an educational title for ages three to six that teaches children about counting skills, as well as matching, sorting, and observation skills. There are games and lessons, as well as a bonus I Spy game, for the targeted age group on the topic of pre-math skills. Dally Doo, a friendly dinosaur, will provide help to the player on any of the activities and games if needed. The game features narration to help the player for extra practice.
